kashif-110.en: When he hears someone claim witnessing (mushāhada) of the Real (al-Ḥaqq), he says: Allah the Exalted said: «Sight does not perceive Him» (Q. 6:103). But the one who witnesses does not claim perception, nor does he see [with] the eyes [?].

kashif-112.en: His words «Sight does not perceive Him» (Q. 6:103) are a general statement open to particularisation; and a saint's (walī) miracle (karāma) particularises definitive knowledge, so how much more a general statement that is only probable?

hikam-p2-7.en: An indication that the servant ought to observe both the sacred Law (sharīʿa) and the Reality (ḥaqīqa): «You alone we worship» (Q. 1:5) is sharīʿa, and «You alone we ask for help» (Q. 1:5) is ḥaqīqa.

kashif-001.en: al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah), «Lord of the worlds, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, King of the Day of Judgement» (Q. 1:2–4), who has poured out upon His saints (awliyāʾ) seas of lights,

kashif-002.en: and singled them out for purity of states and secrets, and occupied them with His remembrance «at evening and at dawn» (Q. 40:55),

kashif-003.en: and upon his family and his Companions, the guiding and the rightly guided, and the Followers and those who followed them in excellence until the Day of Judgement.

kashif-004.en: So I feigned deafness to them for a long while, even though what they were bringing was «a monstrous thing» (Q. 19:27), because I am one of the party of the Flood (fayḍa).

kashif-006.en: The prophetic hadiths contain hints and explicit statements giving glad tidings of this group ⟨who prevail upon the truth⟩, and [the group] has not been confined to one time rather than another, nor to one place rather than another. The Exalted said: «And among those We have created is a community who guide by the truth and by it act justly» (Q. 7:181).

kashif-007.en: See al-Bughya. The Exalted said: «A throng of the first ones, and a throng of the later ones» (Q. 56:39–40). Ibn ʿAbbās narrated: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ⟨Both throngs are of my community.⟩

kashif-008.en: Look with the eye of fairness and you will find that he holds the inheritance in full, so that the community came to have two throngs: a throng for his forefather, namely the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and a throng for him, namely his companions, may Allah be pleased with him.

kashif-011.en: (The fifth): that [the name] is taken from the Bench (ṣuffa) of the Prophet's mosque, which was a dwelling for the People of the Bench, because the sufi follows them in the quality Allah affirmed of them where He said: «And keep yourself patiently with those who call upon their Lord morning and evening, desiring His face» (Q. 18:28).

kashif-012.en: (I say): There is no way to this without companionship with a perfect guiding shaykh. The Exalted said: «O you who believe, be mindful of Allah and seek the means (wasīla) to Him» (Q. 5:35). The means to Allah are many.

kashif-013.en: Among them is following the Prophet in his words and deeds, as the Exalted said: «Say: If you love Allah, follow me; Allah will love you» (Q. 3:31). And in the hadith: ⟨When I love him, I am him⟩. That is the gate of knowledge of Allah (maʿrifa).

kashif-014.en: Among them is companionship with the knower [of Allah] who has arrived (al-ʿārif al-wāṣil), as the Exalted said: «And follow the way of him who turns back to Me» (Q. 31:15).

kashif-015.en: Among them is persevering in the invocations (adhkār). Allah the Exalted said: «And keep yourself patiently with those who call upon their Lord morning and evening, desiring His face» (Q. 18:28). It is known among the people of the path (ṭarīqa) that the invocation (dhikr) which benefits the one who practises it is the one taken from the perfect shaykhs.

kashif-041.en: (I say): People have entered the path in throngs; and perhaps the abrogation of the paths [comes about] when, in not a single one of them, anyone remains who is fit for spiritual training (tarbiya).

kashif-042.en: What has occurred among the Shaykh's companions in abundance of opening (fatḥ), of knowledge of Allah (maʿrifa), and of absorption in Allah through rejecting all that is other than Him, has never occurred in our path, so far as I know, from its emergence until this day of ours. «That is the bounty of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills, and Allah is the Possessor of immense bounty» (Q. 57:21; 62:4).

kashif-043.en: (As for the indications from the Book): the Exalted said: «Whatever verse We abrogate or cause to be forgotten, We bring one better than it or like it» (Q. 2:106).

kashif-044.en: And the Exalted said: «Allah will bring a people whom He loves and who love Him» (Q. 5:54) [to the end of] the verse.

kashif-045.en: And He said: «Then We have entrusted it to a people who do not disbelieve in it» (Q. 6:89).

kashif-046.en: And He said: «And others of them who have not yet joined them» (Q. 62:3).

kashif-047.en: And He said: «When the help of Allah comes, and the opening» (Q. 110:1), to the end.

kashif-048.en: And He said: «And He creates what you do not know» (Q. 16:8). Here, then, are hints, for one whose inner sight (baṣīra) Allah has illumined, that support what has preceded. Drawing them out is left to you. Submit and you will be safe.

kashif-049.en: (And these [are those]) among whom this Flood (fayḍa) has occurred, whose constant occupation is Allah, His Messenger and Shaykh al-Tijānī … They are the ones who keep his lodges (zawāyā) flourishing with the remembrance of Allah through the hours of the night and the ends of the day, by remembrance (dhikr) and by invoking blessing upon their supreme exemplar.

kashif-050.en: Hence the people of this path are tried with denial, through creatures being given power over them … So whoever wants that, let him steel himself for hardship. «Allah defends those who believe» (Q. 22:38). «And whoever relies on Allah, He suffices him» (Q. 65:3). So understand. (And in al-Rimāḥ:)

kashif-059.en: (I say): the Exalted said: «And We have sent down to you the Book as an exposition of all things» (Q. 16:89).

kashif-060.en: And the Exalted said: «We have neglected nothing in the Book» (Q. 6:38).

kashif-061.en: And the Exalted said: «And He creates what you do not know» (Q. 16:8).

kashif-064.en: (I say): Allah the Exalted said: «Wherever you turn, there is the face of Allah» (Q. 2:115).

kashif-065.en: And the Exalted said: «And say: The Real has come and the false has vanished; the false is ever bound to vanish» (Q. 17:81).

kashif-066.en: And the Exalted said: «Rather, We hurl the Real against the false, and it smashes it, and behold, it vanishes» (Q. 21:18).

kashif-067.en: And the Exalted said: «That is because Allah, He is the Real, and what you call upon besides Him is the false» (Q. 31:30).

kashif-068.en: And the Exalted said: «That is because, when Allah alone was called upon, you disbelieved, and if partners were ascribed to Him, you believed» (Q. 40:12).

kashif-069.en: And the Exalted said: «He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, and He has knowledge of all things» (Q. 57:3).

kashif-070.en: And the Exalted said: «We shall show them Our signs on the horizons and in themselves until it becomes clear to them that He is the Real» (Q. 41:53).

kashif-071.en: And the Exalted said: «The Entirely Merciful is established upon the Throne» (Q. 20:5).

kashif-072.en: And the Exalted said: «Say: If the Entirely Merciful had a son, I would be the first of the worshippers» (Q. 43:81).

kashif-073.en: And the Exalted said: «Whoever obeys the Messenger has obeyed Allah» (Q. 4:80).

kashif-074.en: And the Exalted said: «Those who pledge allegiance to you pledge allegiance only to Allah; the hand of Allah is above their hands» (Q. 48:10).

kashif-075.en: And the Exalted said: «You did not throw when you threw, but Allah threw» (Q. 8:17).

kashif-076.en: And the Exalted said: «Say: If you love Allah, follow me; Allah will love you» (Q. 3:31).

kashif-077.en: And the Exalted said: «and believe in what has been sent down upon Muḥammad, and it is the Real» (Q. 47:2).

kashif-078.en: And the Exalted said: «And Allah suffices as witness. Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allah» (Q. 48:28–29) [to the end of] the verse.

kashif-079.en: And the Exalted said: «Whoever obeys Allah and the Messenger, those are with those upon whom Allah has bestowed favour: the prophets, the truthful, the witnesses and the righteous; and how excellent are those as companions!» (Q. 4:69).

kashif-080.en: And the Exalted said: «And he who brought the truth and affirmed it as true, those are the ones who are mindful [of Allah]» (Q. 39:33).

kashif-081.en: And the Exalted said: «How many a sign in the heavens and the earth they pass by, while they turn away from it!» (Q. 12:105).

kashif-082.en: And the Exalted said: «And in yourselves; do you not see?» (Q. 51:21).

kashif-083.en: (The second): invoking blessing upon the Prophet through the hours of the night and the ends of the day, with the intention of obeying the command, and with veneration, exaltation and love.

kashif-085.en: Al-Junayd, may Allah have mercy on him, said: ⟨Whoever has not heard hadith, sat with the jurists, and taken his conduct (adab) from those of refined conduct corrupts whoever follows him.⟩ Allah the Exalted said: «Say: This is my way; I call to Allah upon clear insight, I and whoever follows me» (Q. 12:108) [to the end of] the verse.

kashif-086.en: And He, mighty is He as speaker, said: «And do not follow the [other] paths, lest they scatter you from His path» (Q. 6:153) [to the end of] the verse. So understand.

kashif-087.en: So know that whatever our God wills / comes to be; do not [presume to] will.

kashif-088.en: Hold to [the care of your own] souls, if you are guided, / for one in error has not harmed the rightly guided.

kashif-089.en: And if you pass by idle talk, be noble, / for [mere] speech has never diminished the man of perfection.

kashif-090.en: This statement is supported by His words, the Exalted: «No indeed! On that Day they will be veiled from their Lord; then they will surely burn in the Blaze» (Q. 83:15–16).

kashif-111.en: The denier may argue from His words, the Exalted, «You will not see Me» (Q. 7:143) [to the end of] the verse. Know that His words «You will not see Me» and His words «then you will see Me» are not in contradiction. So understand.

kashif-118.en: that the words of the enraptured (majādhīb) rest on a firm foundation, that all of them are «established with the Lord of the Throne» (Q. 81:20), and that [each] expresses the light of a clear heart.

kashif-119.en: «He utters no word but there is beside him a watcher, ready» (Q. 50:18).

kashif-120.en: and before a little time has passed it becomes clear that he is «among the chosen, the best» (Q. 38:47).

kashif-121.en: It is therefore incumbent on everyone who has come to know this abundant grace to vie for this sublime wird.

kashif-122.en: That draws supply (madad) from the Presence of Absoluteness (ḥaḍrat al-iṭlāq), which supplies it with the vastness of its Lordship. «And for that let those who vie, vie» (Q. 83:26).

kashif-123.en: and [that He] string us on the thread of the noble Seal (khatm), «on the Day when neither wealth nor sons avail, except him who comes to Allah with a sound heart» (Q. 26:88–89).

kashif-124.en: And it is Allah I ask to accept [this] for us, and to turn towards us [?], at the beginning and at the end; for He is the One who originates and restores, the All-Forgiving, the Loving, Possessor of the Throne, the Glorious, Doer of whatever He wills.

kashif-137.en: (I say:) The scholars of evil, slaves of their passions, are not meant by this; they are the worst of those whom the sky shades.

kashif-154.en: (I say:) The secret of opening our wird with seeking refuge [in Allah] (istiʿādha) is that Allah informed us that Satan is an enemy to us and commanded us to take him as an enemy. The Exalted said: «Satan is an enemy to you, so take him as an enemy» (Q. 35:6). The way to take an enemy as an enemy is constant guarding against him by fortifying oneself

kashif-155.en: (As for al-Fātiḥa,) it suffices you of its merit that it is the Mother of the Qurʾan and the Seven Oft-Repeated [verses].

kashif-160.en: Then (seek Allah's forgiveness a hundred times). The Exalted said: «and seek your Lord's forgiveness» (Q. 11:3).

kashif-161.en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ⟨Allah the Exalted sent down to me two safeguards for my community: «Allah would not punish them while you are among them, and Allah would not punish them while they seek forgiveness» (Q. 8:33). So when I pass on, I leave among them the seeking of forgiveness.⟩

kashif-162.en: ⟨One came to me from my Lord and said: «Whoever does evil or wrongs himself, then seeks Allah's forgiveness, will find Allah All-Forgiving, Especially Merciful» (Q. 4:110)⟩

kashif-163.en: The verse before it, «Whoever does evil will be requited for it» (Q. 4:123), had weighed heavily on them.

kashif-165.en: Ibn Jarīr [al-Ṭabarī] and Ibn al-Mundhir related from Ibn ʿAbbās concerning the saying of the Exalted, «Whoever does evil or wrongs himself, then seeks Allah's forgiveness» (Q. 4:110): he said, ⟨Allah the Exalted informed His servants of His forbearance, His pardon and His generosity

kashif-166.en: …along with other such [reports] that are well known. «And Allah speaks the truth, and He guides to the way» (Q. 33:4). End [of quotation].

kashif-167.en: Then (O Allah, bless our master Muḥammad, the Opener) etc., a hundred times. The Exalted said: «Allah and His angels bless the Prophet. O you who believe, bless him and greet him with a full greeting» (Q. 33:56).

kashif-171.en: Then «Glorified is your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they describe. And peace be upon the messengers. And al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah), the Lord of the worlds» (Q. 37:180–182).

kashif-172.en: Allah the Exalted said: «And glorify Him at dawn and at dusk» (Q. 33:42).

kashif-177.en: (There is no god but Allah) a hundred times. The Exalted said: «And remember Allah much» (Q. 8:45).

kashif-205.en: This much suffices. Allah grants success to what is right, and to Him, glorified is He, is the return and the final homecoming. Then «Allah and His angels bless the Prophet. O you who believe, bless him and greet him with a full greeting» (Q. 33:56).

kashif-206.en: «Glorified is your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they describe. And peace be upon the messengers. And al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah), the Lord of the worlds» (Q. 37:180–182). We have already spoken about the blessing upon the Prophet ﷺ and about the glorification (tasbīḥ).

kashif-207.en: Then (I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Magnificent, «besides whom there is no god, the Living, the Self-Subsisting» (Q. 2:255)) thirty times.

kashif-208.en: The blessing (ṣalāt) of the alif is sheer self-disclosure (tajallī) and supply (madad) by way of attributes; the blessing of the lām-alif is sheer subsistence of an attribute in the one it qualifies; and the blessing of the hāʾ is sheer absence (ghayba) and absorption (istighrāq). So «glorified is your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they describe» (Q. 37:180).

kashif-209.en: Then («Glorified is your Lord», etc.) (Q. 37:180–182); this has been discussed already. Then (There is no god but Allah) a hundred times; this has been discussed already.

kashif-210.en: So the human being professed [Allah's] oneness with 'There is no god but Allah', and so was made a khalīfa in the Jewel of Perfection (Jawharat al-kamāl); and [so] the waẓīfa ended: «Allah and His angels» etc. (Q. 33:56).

kashif-211.en: (As for the remembrance (dhikr) of the haylala) after the afternoon prayer on Friday, its manner is: seeking refuge [in Allah] (istiʿādha), the basmala, and al-Fātiḥa once; the istighfār of the collective litany (waẓīfa) three times; the Ṣalāt al-Fātiḥ three times; then «Allah and His angels» etc. (Q. 33:56) once.

kashif-212.en: and the Ṣalāt al-Fātiḥ three times; then «Allah and His angels» etc. (Q. 33:56) once; then 'There is no god but Allah' until sunset.

kashif-214.en: And Allah the Exalted said concerning Friday: «When the prayer is ended, disperse through the land and seek of Allah's bounty, and remember Allah much, that you may prosper» (Q. 62:10).

kashif-215.en: So none disparages the litanies (adhkār) of the Folk except one who is ignorant or obstinate. «And since they are not guided by it, they will say: “This is an ancient falsehood”» (Q. 46:11).

kashif-235.en: Know that nothing is impossible with respect to Allah except that He should have a partner, exalted is He far above that!

kashif-237.en: So look, may Allah have mercy on you, at how he singled out the people of Salmān for that, while there was no Black person [?] in the gathering besides him; [thus] you know that the Black peoples may well have among them the good [?].

kashif-246.en: Know that being female does not prevent one from joining the chosen, excellent servants of Allah.

kashif-247.en: For Allah, blessed and exalted is He, did not mention men in any station (maqām) without pairing the mention of them with the mention of women, as in His saying, the Exalted: «The Muslim men and the Muslim women» up to His saying «and the men who remember Allah much and the women who remember: Allah has prepared for them forgiveness and a tremendous reward» (Q. 33:35).

kashif-248.en: And look at what has come in the Mighty Qurʾan, to which «falsehood does not come, from before it or from behind it» (Q. 41:42), in mentioning Maryam and extolling her.

kashif-249.en: The truth is that she is a woman of utter truthfulness (ṣiddīqa), since prophethood comes about only in men, as proven by His saying, the Exalted: «and his mother was a ṣiddīqa» (Q. 5:75).

kashif-257.en: Its completion was on the eighth day of the Sacred Muḥarram, in the year 1351, in the town of Kosi. («Glorified is your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they describe. And peace be upon the messengers. And al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah), the Lord of the worlds» (Q. 37:180–182))

tabsira-001.en: The Exalted said, and He is the most truthful of speakers: «And He taught Ādam the names, all of them» (Q. 2:31) [to the end of] the verse.

tabsira-002.en: al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah), Who «sent down the Qurʾan as guidance for mankind and as clear proofs of guidance and of the Criterion» (Q. 2:185).

tabsira-003.en: Introduction. Know — may Allah increase us and you in amplitude of knowledge and of body, and in soundness of perception and understanding — that the merit of a person which entitles him to precedence in religion is attained by acquisition, not by mere affiliation [by descent].

tabsira-004.en: Section One: On a brief account of the merit of scholars and of seekers of knowledge. So I say: know — may Allah increase me and you in amplitude of knowledge and of body, and in soundness of perception and understanding —

tabsira-005.en: The Exalted said: «Whoever is given wisdom has been given much good» (Q. 2:269).

tabsira-006.en: And the Exalted said: «Allah bears witness that there is no god but He, and [so do] the angels and those possessed of knowledge» (Q. 3:18).

tabsira-007.en: The Exalted said: «And He taught you what you did not know, and the bounty of Allah upon you has been immense» (Q. 4:113).

tabsira-008.en: The completion of its drafting took place in the year sixty-six after one thousand three hundred (1366 AH) — «and Allah will never grant the unbelievers a way over the believers» (Q. 4:141) — in the city of Kaolack, may Allah guard it from every evil and harm, by the rank of Shaykh Abū al-ʿAbbās, may Allah be pleased with him, and of his followers. Amen.

tabsira-009.en: As for ampleness in foods and clothing, it is derived from the hadith ⟨Allah loves to see the trace of His blessing upon His servant⟩, and the Book indicates it: «Say: who has forbidden the adornment of Allah which He brought forth for His servants, and the good things of provision?» (Q. 7:32); «and ornaments that you wear» (Q. 16:14); «and as for the blessing of your Lord, speak [of it]» (Q. 93:11).

tabsira-010.en: And may Allah be pleased with the Companions, who shaded us with the shade of faith and excellence (iḥsān), and with those who followed them, the people of felicity, triumph and [divine] good pleasure, and with those who followed them in excellence until the Day of the recompense of excellence.

tabsira-011.en: I have set down this treatise to alert the sons and the brothers, and especially those whose fathers and grandfathers were people of knowledge and of knowledge of Allah (ʿirfān), as counsel to them. And Allah is the One whose help is sought. «And my success is only through Allah» (Q. 11:88); upon Him is reliance and trust.

tabsira-012.en: And the Exalted said: «We raise by degrees whomever We will, and above every possessor of knowledge is one more knowing» (Q. 12:76).

tabsira-013.en: And the Exalted said: «And We taught him knowledge from Our own presence» (Q. 18:65).

tabsira-015.en: And blessing and peace be upon the one to whom was sent down «And say: My Lord, increase me in knowledge» (Q. 20:114), the best of the sons of ʿAdnān.

tabsira-016.en: And the Exalted said: «And say: My Lord, increase me in knowledge» (Q. 20:114).

tabsira-017.en: By Allah's Name: The Entirely Merciful, The Especially Merciful. And may Allah bless our master Muḥammad, the Opener, the Seal, and his Family, as befits his true worth and his immense measure. «Rather, it is clear signs in the breasts of those who have been given knowledge, and none denies Our signs except the wrongdoers» (Q. 29:49).

tabsira-018.en: And the Exalted said: «Only the scholars among His servants fear Allah» (Q. 35:28).

tabsira-019.en: And the Exalted said: «Are those who know and those who do not know equal?» (Q. 39:9).

tabsira-020.en: Indeed, what has come in the Mighty Book, «which falsehood does not reach from before it or from behind it» (Q. 41:42), in praise of knowledge and scholars suffices whoever reflects on it; and likewise the prophetic hadiths, the reports (āthār) and the sayings of the eminent [authorities].

tabsira-021.en: And the division of innovation (bidʿa) into the aforementioned categories, and into good and bad, has no trace of knowledge behind it, because no proof indicating it has come down.

tabsira-022.en: He is «the Entirely Merciful … He created man; He taught him clear expression» (Q. 55:1–4).

tabsira-023.en: And the Exalted said: «The Entirely Merciful taught the Qurʾan, created man, taught him clear expression» (Q. 55:1–4).

tabsira-024.en: And the Exalted said: «Allah raises by degrees those of you who believe and those who have been given knowledge» (Q. 58:11).

tabsira-025.en: And the Exalted said: «Read in the name of your Lord who created, created man from a clinging clot. Read, and your Lord is the Most Generous, who taught by the pen, taught man what he did not know» (Q. 96:1–5).

qanabil-q1-1.en: So the faith of the two of them is not complete until they make him judge in what has arisen in dispute between them, as the verse indicates: «But no, by your Lord, they will not believe until they make you judge in what has arisen in dispute between them» (Q. 4:65).

qanabil-q2-2.en: Allah's enmity towards him is understood from His words, the Exalted: «Whoever is an enemy to Allah and His angels …» [to the end of] the verse (Q. 2:98).

qanabil-q2-3.en: because Allah placed him before them in mention, in His words, the Exalted: «then Allah, He is his Protector, and Gabriel, and the righteous among the believers; and the angels, after that, are [his] supporters» (Q. 66:4). Our Shaykh al-Tijānī took this verse as proof that the righteous among the believers are superior to the angels.

qanabil-q8-4.en: So respecting the sons of the righteous is part of respecting the righteous. Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, has said: «and their father was a righteous man» (Q. 18:82).

qanabil-q8-5.en: and [He] joins him to his father's rank, in view of His words, the Exalted: «And those who believed and whose offspring followed them in faith, We shall join their offspring to them» (Q. 52:21).

qanabil-q8-6.en: or I declare them cut off from their fathers, leave them to what they are in, and say concerning them: «He is not of your family; he is unrighteous conduct» (Q. 11:46).

qanabil-q10-7.en: I say, before anything else, that the speech of the saints (awliyāʾ): «none knows its interpretation except Allah. And those firmly rooted in knowledge say: We believe in it; all is from our Lord» (Q. 3:7).

qanabil-q10-8.en: as is the case with the openings of the suras: none knows them except one who understands what they signify. So much so that when Gabriel, peace be upon him, brought the Prophet ﷺ «Kāf Hā Yā ʿAyn Ṣād» (Q. 19:1), the Prophet ﷺ began to say at each letter, ⟨I know [it]⟩.

qanabil-q10-9.en: If what is meant by prostration is submission, as in His words, the Exalted: «and when the Qurʾan is recited to them, they do not prostrate» (Q. 84:21), that is, they do not submit, then there is no difficulty.

qanabil-q10-10.en: every age, and sees what it holds of promise and threat. «For it is not the eyes that go blind; rather, the hearts within the breasts go blind» (Q. 22:46).

qanabil-q10-11.en: «And the evil plot encompasses none but its own people» (Q. 35:43).

qanabil-q10-12.en: «And say: Work, for Allah will see your work, and His Messenger, and the believers; and you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you of what you used to do» (Q. 9:105). ⟨So may the worse of you two be ransom for the better of you two⟩.

qanabil-q15-13.en: The Real has pointed to this with His words, Blessed and Exalted is He: «O people, We created you from a male and a female» (Q. 49:13). The male, in reality, is the Name, and the female, in reality, is the Attribute.

qanabil-q15-14.en: Likewise «from between the backbone and the breastbones» (Q. 86:7): between the backbone of the Name and the breastbones of the Attribute, on the pattern given above.

qanabil-q15-15.en: and the two are the root of every pair. «And of everything We created pairs, that you might take heed. So flee to Allah; I am to you a clear warner from Him. And do not set up another god alongside Allah; I am to you a clear warner from Him» (Q. 51:49–51). Allah the Tremendous has spoken truly.

qanabil-q15-16.en: So I explained the meaning of the words of the Father (al-wālid): that he means the two men who are the manifestation of the two attributes he spoke of in riddles, that is, the manifestation of Beauty and Majesty.

qanabil-q15-17.en: So I said to him: I too can do that, from His words, the Exalted: «And a man said» (Q. 40:28).

qanabil-q16-18.en: I said: Far-fetched. And Allah knows best where Barhām [?] is and what Barhām [?] is … ⟨The one asked knows no better than the one asking⟩ … «and He creates what you do not know» (Q. 16:8).

qanabil-q16-19.en: «And upon Allah rests the showing of the straight way» (Q. 16:9).

qanabil-q16-20.en: … O Allah, «guide us to the straight path» (Q. 1:6).

qanabil-q17-21.en: So the purified shariʿa, after His words, the Exalted: «This day I have perfected for you your religion, completed My blessing upon you, and approved for you Islam as religion» (Q. 5:3), was sealed; it neither increases nor decreases.

qanabil-q17-22.en: Among them: that the reality (ḥaqīqa) must have an existence proper to it, of firstness and lastness, or of manifestness or hiddenness.

qanabil-q18-23.en: It remains only for us to grasp that His words, the Exalted, «O Prophet, be wary of Allah» (Q. 33:1), after He had addressed him by prophethood and commanded him to be wary [of Allah], [mean] that this wariness (taqwā) is particular to his station.

qanabil-q18-24.en: and the wariness (taqwā) of the elect, which is wariness of forbidden things … and this is what is meant by His words, the Exalted: «So be wary of Allah as far as you are able» (Q. 64:16).

qanabil-q18-25.en: and the wariness (taqwā) of the elect of the elect, which is wariness of anything other than Allah passing through the mind, and this is what is meant by His words, the Exalted: «Be wary of Allah with the wariness due to Him» (Q. 3:102).

qanabil-q18-26.en: «And be wary of Me, O people of understanding (ulū l-albāb)» (Q. 2:197) … So His words, the Exalted, «And be wary of Me, O people of understanding» (Q. 2:197) are a command to part of the wariness (taqwā) of hearts.

qanabil-q18-27.en: We understand from His words, Blessed and Exalted is He, «then it is of the wariness (taqwā) of hearts» (Q. 22:32), that it is the utmost of wariness and that it cannot be encompassed, by the evidence of the partitive min.

qanabil-q19-28.en: I said: In this verse there is something particular to the last [generation] of this community … And the noble verse holds another allusion, in that it comes in four divisions: the first division, «those who believe»; the second division, «[and] do righteous deeds»; the third, «enjoin one another to the truth»; the fourth, «enjoin one another to patience» (Q. 103:3). So a correspondence obtains between the afternoon (ʿaṣr), which is the end of the day, and patience, which is the last of the ranks.

qanabil-q19-29.en: I say that it is a sign of the nearness of the Hour, as in His words, the Exalted: «When the earth is shaken with its shaking, and the earth brings forth its burdens …» (Q. 99:1–2).

qanabil-q19-30.en: And as in His words, the Exalted: «until, when the earth has taken on its finery and been adorned, and its people think they have power over it …» [to the end of] the verse (Q. 10:24).

qanabil-q19-31.en: And the wisdom in it is «that those who believe may increase in faith …» [to the end of] the verse (Q. 74:31).

qanabil-q19-32.en: We ask Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, to grant us intimacy [with Him] and to occupy us with His concealed things (katmiyyāt) away from all else; «and the last of their call is: al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah), Lord of the worlds» (Q. 10:10).

qanabil-p04-01.en: We do not speak of Allah's distance unless we say it in the sense of His dealing [with someone] as distance requires, just as you say ‘Allah's guile’ and ‘Allah's scheming’ in His anger. Allah is far above these attributes; and since they have come in His speech, we know that their meaning is dealing as [they] require.

qanabil-p05-02.en: That Allah is nearer than the jugular vein and comes between a man and his heart is a real matter that does not change in any state whatever.

qanabil-p05-03.en: That Allah is nearer than the jugular vein and comes between a man and his heart is a real matter that does not change in any state whatever.

qanabil-p05-04.en: As for nearness in the sense of help, it is His nearness to those who do good (al-muḥsinūn).

qanabil-p05-05.en: The Prophet, who passed beyond the seven heavens, the Throne and the Rafraf until he was «two bows' length or nearer» (Q. 53:9): Allah is not nearer to him in this state than to Yūnus

qanabil-p05-06.en: than to Yūnus, who fell into three darknesses

qanabil-p05-07.en: So whenever he found an opportunity to kill a self (nafs), he killed it by Allah; that is, «Allah effaces what He wills» of the self's egoity (anāniyya) «and establishes» what He wills of His egoity (Q. 13:39).

qanabil-p06-08.en: In this sense a human being becomes «the worst of creatures» (Q. 98:6), [worse] even than beasts of prey, because of the slave who works with his self for his selfish interests.

qanabil-p07-09.en: By this a human being becomes «the best of creatures» (Q. 98:7), [better] even than the angels, because they are among the creatures.

qanabil-p07-10.en: If he subjugates it to himself, it becomes an instrument of good, being «well-pleased and well-pleasing» (Q. 89:28).

qanabil-p09-11.en: «Those are the best of creatures» (Q. 98:7). And do not ask about the enemies of Allah; may Allah spare us their evil.

qanabil-p10-12.en: Among them: that Allah replaces his evil deeds for him with their good deeds.

qanabil-p10-13.en: His real aim is opposition to the people of Allah, and that is putting out Allah's light; the saint (walī) has no aim but to make Allah's light manifest.

qanabil-p11-14.en: and that the One remembered, who is Allah, hears only what the denier hears. So exalted is Allah «above what they say, greatly exalted» (Q. 17:43).

qanabil-p11-15.en: It is as though his heart, for him, were the Preserved Tablet, or rather the Mother of the Book, which is the presence that contains what is in the Tablet, while the Tablet does not contain what is in it.

qanabil-p12-16.en: I know that he has «mixed a righteous deed with another that is bad; perhaps Allah will turn to him» (Q. 9:102).

qanabil-p15-17.en: When I reached him, the sun rose for me from the west, «and the one who disbelieved was dumbfounded» (Q. 2:258).

qanabil-p18-18.en: for the first of them is khilāfa on behalf of Allah, like the khilāfa of Ādam and Dāwūd.

qanabil-p18-19.en: and no claimant has claimed sonship to Allah for them, as it was claimed for ʿĪsā, peace be upon him, and for ʿUzayr.

qanabil-p18-20.en: in this corrupt age, in which the people of ignorance and darkness have prevailed and have cast the sacred law (sharīʿa) and the reality (ḥaqīqa) «behind their backs» (Q. 2:101).

qanabil-p19-21.en: and, as you know, the Shaykh holds fast to them with his molars through the hours of the night and the ends of the day.

qanabil-p19-22.en: So all that they were upon was effaced by it: «the truth has come and falsehood has vanished» (Q. 17:81).

qanabil-p23-23.en: on condition that he takes issue with every one of the saints who has spoken in this tongue, unless he is one of those who «believe in some and disbelieve in some» (Q. 4:150).

qanabil-p23-24.en: It is well known that a piece of unbelief from which Iblīs held back is one that no Muslim who recites the Book of Allah through the hours of the night and the ends of the day would dare.

qanabil-p24-25.en: The reality of envy is that it is a chronic disease … it begins with the one who has it and kills him. «Whoever does righteousness, it is for his own self; and whoever does evil, it is against it» (Q. 41:46; 45:15).

qanabil-p26-26.en: Whoever understands what I have pointed to knows that blackness and whiteness, there is no difference between them, and «bounty is in the hand of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills» (Q. 3:73; 57:29).

qanabil-p29-27.en: Each of the two names has an even and an odd. «The even and the odd» (Q. 89:3), for us, are what we have mentioned; and the even and the odd, for them, are what Ibn ʿArabī mentioned.

qanabil-p31-28.en: So the secret of the absolute making-known (al-taʿarruf al-muṭlaq) is that for which Allah made the Muḥammadan Reality manifest. And «al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah), Lord of the worlds» (Q. 1:2).

qanabil-p31-29.en: It is as though it were an image of what came before: it is the extended shade and the existing isthmus (barzakh).

qanabil-p38-30.en: I give you an example in His words, the Exalted: «He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden» (Q. 57:3). The one in annihilation in the Essence (al-fanāʾ fī l-dhāt) sees that there is no first, no last, no manifest and no hidden except the Essence alone.

qanabil-p39-31.en: the wariness (taqwā) of the common people, which is wariness of associating [partners] with Allah, and this is what is meant by His words, the Exalted: «O people, be wary of your Lord» (Q. 4:1; 22:1; 31:33).

qanabil-p40-32.en: Know that the people of understanding (ulū l-albāb), in truth, are the poles (aqṭāb) … For between His words, the Exalted, «And be wary of Me, O people of understanding» (Q. 2:197) and His words «O Prophet, be wary of Allah» (Q. 33:1) there is a correspondence

qanabil-p40-33.en: and His words «O Prophet, be wary of Allah» (Q. 33:1): between them there is a correspondence, namely that all of it falls within the scope of the wariness (taqwā) of hearts.

qanabil-p40-34.en: So every presence (ḥaḍra) has an even and an odd: the even in every presence is what corresponds to the spirit (rūḥ) and what corresponds to the bodily form (shabaḥ), and the odd in every presence is what corresponds to the core (lubb).

qanabil-p40-35.en: So by passing beyond it within himself he becomes a core (lubb) within himself, and by its passing beyond it [?] he becomes [a core] in his sanctity (quds). «And none takes heed but the people of understanding (ulū l-albāb)» (Q. 2:269; 3:7).

qanabil-p41-36.en: May Allah make us and you among «those who believe and do righteous deeds and enjoin one another to the truth and enjoin one another to patience» (Q. 103:3).

qanabil-p42-37.en: So the Hereafter appears to them in the form of this world, that they may grow at ease with it, and «that they may increase in faith along with their faith» (Q. 48:4), and that the people of this world may increase in faith in their world.

qanabil-p42-38.en: Just as this world, in its origin, is a painful punishment for one party and forgiveness and good pleasure from Allah for another party

qanabil-p42-39.en: From another angle: just as the earth of the reality (ḥaqīqa) has «brought forth its burdens» (Q. 99:2), so too the earth of the form (ṣūra); its concealed things (katmiyyāt) must appear.

qanabil-niasse-p09.en:
The Shaykh [Ibrāhīm] pointed to this in his words:
He made harm run from them lest you lean / toward them; rather, toward Allah lean.

qanabil-niasse-p40.en: The verse: the Shaykh [Ibrāhīm] spoke on it, and among what he said on it is that «By the afternoon» (Q. 103:1) is an oath by the life of the Prophet ﷺ, that is, his era (ʿaṣr), or that it is an oath by time (dahr); and the one and the other mean the same thing for the people of the reality (ḥaqīqa).

qanabil-niasse-p41.en: Among the Shaykh's words: ⟨Know that when a great one says something, even if he does not swear to it, it must be true … and he had sworn to what he said⟩. And Allah has sworn that there is no deliverance from loss except through four [things]: faith in Allah, doing righteous deeds, enjoining one another to the truth, and enjoining one another to patience.

rijal-001.en:
By Allah's Name: The Entirely Merciful, The Especially Merciful. And may Allah bless our master Muḥammad, his Family and his Companions, and grant [them] abundant peace. «al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah), Lord of the worlds, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, King of the Day of Judgement. You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help. Guide us on the straight path, the path of those whom You have blessed, not of those who incur wrath, nor of those who go astray» (Q. 1:2–7). Amen. To proceed: the servant of his Lord and seeker of His nearness, Ibrāhīm b. al-Ḥājj ʿAbd Allāh al-Tijānī, says …

«al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh, Lord of the worlds, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, King of the Day of Judgement» (Q. 1:2–4), outwardly and inwardly. To proceed …

By Allah's Name: The Entirely Merciful, The Especially Merciful. «al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh, Lord of the worlds, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, King of the Day of Judgement» (Q. 1:2–4). And may Allah bless the pre-eternity of pre-eternity, and be pleased with pre-eternity.

By Allah's Name: The Entirely Merciful, The Especially Merciful. And may Allah bless our master Muḥammad, his Family and his Companions, and grant [them] abundant peace. «al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh, Lord of the worlds, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, King of the Day of Judgement» (Q. 1:2–4). To proceed: the servant of his Lord and seeker of His nearness, Ibrāhīm b. al-Ḥājj ʿAbd Allāh al-Tijānī, says: I have authorised and licensed …

rijal-002.en: So hold fast to reciting the Book of Allah as it truly should be recited, and to remembering Allah abundantly with the tongue and the heart …

rijal-003.en: al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah). My dear son, Sīdī Muḥammad al-ʿĀqib Ibrāhīm Niasse: I have permitted you to recite the Qurʾan as much as you are able, in the hours of the night and at the ends of the day; and I hope that Allah will grant you to recite it as it truly should be recited, and will preserve you and grant you success. Amen. Your tender father, Ibrāhīm Niasse.

rijal-004.en: And never sully your honour with any insult, disgrace or infamy, above all a disgrace that drags [one] to the Fire, and wretched is the destination … And never take tobacco (al-sikār), for it is foul in name, in quality and in essence.

rijal-005.en: al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah) in every state, and «truly we belong to Allah, and truly to Him we are returning» (Q. 2:156). My brother, the most learned scholar and gnostic (al-ʿārif), al-Sayyid Abū Bakr al-Muthannā, died on Sunday, when seven [nights] had passed of Jumādā al-Thāniya, in the year one thousand three hundred and ninety-three …

rijal-006.en: Next, to inform [you] that news has reached me of the death of your son, the Shaykh. «Truly we belong to Allah, and truly to Him we are returning» (Q. 2:156), and al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah) in every state. Say with your heart and your tongue: «Truly we belong to Allah, and truly to Him we are returning» (Q. 2:156), and al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh. And know that the death of this son of yours is a great mark of honour (karāma) with which your Lord has honoured you.

rijal-007.en: And I ask Him to increase you in «amplitude in knowledge and body» (Q. 2:247), and in grasp in knowledge and understanding.

rijal-008.en: And I have given you a litany (ḥizb) from the litanies of the Tijānī Seal, which he kept up constantly for his own person: it is ten [recitations] of the Throne Verse (Āyat al-Kursī) after the afternoon prayer, on Thursday only; and its secret is great. Peace. Written by Ibrāhīm b. al-Ḥājj ʿAbd Allāh al-Tijānī in the year 1355.

rijal-009.en: And I say to you both what the khalīfa ʿAlī Ḥarāzim said to his panegyrist al-Riyāḥī, letter for letter, exactly alike; and that suffices you as a reward. I say: the text of the aforementioned khalīfa's words is: … and your rope has been joined to a handhold that has no breaking …

rijal-010.en: And I believe «in Allah, His angels, His books and His messengers; we make no distinction between any of His messengers» (Q. 2:285), to the end of what the close of Sūrat al-Baqara contains.

rijal-011.en: You are the One who provides for whom You will; / whenever You will, You will as You will, what they willed [?]

rijal-012.en: I will not lengthen my words, for Sīdī ʿAlī Sīs suffices in every matter [in my place]; and Allah suffices him and suffices us, and an excellent Guardian [is He]. Peace.

rijal-013.en: My dear daughter, al-Sayyida Ruqayya bt. al-Ḥājj ʿAbd Allāh: keep constantly to the dhikr of the wird of the ḥasbala ['Allah suffices us'], four hundred and fifty [times], preceded by «Those to whom the people said, 'The people have gathered against you, so fear them'; but it increased them in faith, and they said, 'Allah suffices us, and an excellent Guardian [is He].' So they returned with grace from Allah and bounty; no harm touched them; they followed the good pleasure of Allah; and Allah is Possessor of great bounty» (Q. 3:173–174). And when the number is complete, close with the verse as well. Peace. Ibrāhīm Niasse, al-Muḥarram 1389.

rijal-014.en: For we hold to the covenant and keep the pledge until the meeting with Allah, and this world is the enjoyment of delusion. ⟨O Allah, do not make this world our greatest concern, nor the limit of our knowledge.⟩

rijal-015.en: Then the Shaykh advised them to recite the Qurʾan on tapes, 'because' — as the Shaykh said — 'I have seen the Jews intent on distorting «words from their places» (Q. 4:46) in writing.'

rijal-016.en: al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah). The most learned al-Ḥājj Muḥammad Zaynab died when two nights remained of Sh[…] in the year 1366; «and Allah will never grant the disbelievers a way over the believers» (Q. 4:141). And I said, praying for him:

rijal-017.en: Next, to inform [you] that I guarantee — by my secret, my spirit, my intellect, my heart and my self — to your secret, your spirit, your intellect, your heart and your self, the attainment of all aims, what is outward of them and what is inward …

rijal-018.en: The Shaykh, may Allah be pleased with him, said to Ibra Fall: … Ibra Fall, «truly my prayer, my rites, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds» (Q. 6:162).

rijal-019.en: and a portion for himself, in which he partakes of the good things Allah has made lawful for him.

rijal-020.en: «al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah), who guided us to this; and we would never have been guided had Allah not guided us» (Q. 7:43).

rijal-021.en: O Allah, I ask You by what the Muḥammadan Reality (al-ḥaqīqa al-Muḥammadiyya) has concealed, and by the Muḥammadan Reality and its hidden secret, to take us by our hands … and to pour upon us the oceans of Your knowledges and Your secrets, and to open upon us the blessings of heaven and earth, and to mend for us every rent … and to grant us the Word and bringing-into-being (al-kalima wa-l-takwīn) …

rijal-022.en: and that He subject to you all that He has created, and take you into His care, for «He takes the righteous into His care» (Q. 7:196).

rijal-023.en: And Allah takes us and you into His care, for «He takes the righteous into His care» (Q. 7:196). Peace.

rijal-024.en: And let them be earnest in supplication, for the will to extinguish the light of Allah continues; yet «Allah refuses» (Q. 9:32) continues too.

rijal-025.en: And that our master Muḥammad b. ʿAbd Allāh is His servant and His messenger, whom He sent «with the truth as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner» (Q. 2:119) ⟨before the Hour⟩; He sent him «with the guidance and the religion of truth, to make it prevail over all religion, even though the idolaters be averse» (Q. 9:33), the seal of the prophets and messengers.

rijal-026.en: Next, to inform [you] that I am in well-being and safety. I have heard what you indicated to me concerning the matter of the pharaohs: «do not grieve; truly Allah is with us» (Q. 9:40). And know that, as for Allah, no stratagem, no supplication, no sorcery, nor anything affects His locus of manifestation (maẓhar) …

rijal-027.en: They sold their selves, and then their wealth too,

rijal-028.en: And the last of our call is that «al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah), Lord of the worlds» (Q. 10:10), and «peace be upon the messengers» (Q. 37:181).

rijal-029.en: My beloved son, namesake of my beloved, Muḥammad al-Hādī: peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. I ask Allah the Exalted to heal your eyes, to let you enjoy them for the length of your life, and to hasten the cure so that you return to pursuing your lessons; and that is not difficult for Allah. Further: recite over them every morning and evening: «Go with this shirt of mine … all together» (Q. 12:93).

rijal-030.en: and «that is not difficult for Allah» (Q. 14:20).

rijal-031.en: For I have prayed for you all, as I have prayed for the rest of the disciples in the Two Noble Sanctuaries, [with prayers] that I hope Allah the Exalted will answer; and «that is not difficult for Allah» (Q. 14:20).

rijal-032.en: al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah), and thanks are for Allah; «whatever blessing you have is from Allah» (Q. 16:53), «and my success is only through Allah» (Q. 11:88), and there is no power and no strength except through Allah … O dutiful daughter, al-Sayyida Ruqayya: I have read your treatise

rijal-033.en:
May Allah bring you back safe and laden with gain, [with] a pilgrimage accepted, an effort rewarded, and sins forgiven.

I found my son al-Ḥājj ʿAbd Allāh, / namesake of my father, the Allah-fearing, the oft-sighing (al-awwāh)

rijal-034.en: [He] saw, in what the sleeper sees, Shaykh Ibrāhīm Niasse in the midst of a great crowd, who were saying 'There is no god but Allah' and 'Allah is greatest', while Shaykh Ibrāhīm repeated the words of the Exalted: «To each — these and those — We extend from the gift of your Lord; and the gift of your Lord is not withheld» (Q. 17:20).

rijal-035.en: And he recalls that they were a group, among them al-Sayyid Alman Niasse, who would sit at the Shaykh's door in Kossi at night, doing dhikr from after the night prayer until dawn. Once the Shaykh said to them: 'Do not raise your voices, nor lower them, but «seek a way between that»' (Q. 17:110).

rijal-036.en: «al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah), Lord of the worlds, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, King of the Day of Judgement» (Q. 1:2–4). «al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh, who has not taken a son, and has no partner in the dominion, and has no protector out of weakness; and magnify Him with all magnification» (Q. 17:111).

rijal-037.en:
al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah). «So grant me from Yourself an heir who will inherit from me» (Q. 19:5–6).
To the presence of my eldest son, namesake of my father, al-Ḥājj ʿAbd Allāh, may Allah preserve him … So be lofty in spiritual resolve (himma), and be a disciple, not merely a son; for none inherits what I have except the sincere disciple, be he son, brother or stranger. For we are not inherited by mere affiliation, but by striving, sincerity and acquisition.

rijal-038.en:
At Ṭayba [?] I have come to You, my Lord, repentant, / seeking, humble and returning.
In a blessed abode set me down, / and benefit here all who have come to me.

rijal-039.en: To the presence of the lordly gnostic, possessor of the secret of the Self-Sufficient (al-sirr al-ṣamadānī) … the most pleasing son, the most favoured disciple, the approved exemplar, one whom «neither trade nor selling distracts from the remembrance of Allah» (Q. 24:37), the profitable merchant and righteous friend of Allah, Maḥmūd b. al-Sayyid ʿAlī Jūb.

rijal-040.en: The Shaykh, may Allah be pleased with him, wished to pass through this world as the noble pass by, had it not been for the two schemers at whose hands the hidden things were divulged and the hiding places brought to light.

rijal-041.en: «Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and our offspring a coolness of eyes, and make us an imam for the Allah-fearing» (Q. 25:74). And I, O my son and coolness of my eye, counsel you …

rijal-042.en: Next, to inform [you] that «my breast is constricted and my tongue is not loosed» (Q. 26:13); but this year, in which the righteous so often gave me glad tidings of attaining what I desired … that it is the hardest year for me.

rijal-043.en:
«al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah)», and [He] suffices, «and peace be upon His servants whom He has chosen» (Q. 27:59). To proceed: …

«al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh», and [He] suffices, «and peace be upon His servants whom He has chosen» (Q. 27:59). To proceed: to my sweet basil, the part of me, my beloved, al-Sayyida Maryam …

rijal-044.en: and that He set right all our affairs; and that is easy for Him.

rijal-045.en: And as that befalls you, it befalls your family and everyone attached to you; and He lavishes His blessings upon you, outward and inward; and your love for us ever increases and never diminishes …

rijal-046.en: Ibra Fall: «O people of Yathrib, there is no place for you to stand, so go back» (Q. 33:13).

rijal-047.en:
Affirming the truth, giving in charity, / fasting perpetually, keeping guard;
they sold their selves, and then their wealth too, / like the believers — how fine [their] states!

rijal-048.en: Ibra Fall: «And man bore it; truly he was most wrongful, most ignorant» (Q. 33:72).

rijal-049.en: Soften for them, [O] You who softened iron, / for whom You have willed, and lift the shackles.

rijal-050.en: and he should not turn his attention to their worldly goods, for the servant's provision is his Master's charge; and He is the Rich, the Praiseworthy, the Generous, the Noble; and He is the Giver and the Withholder, the Abaser and the Exalter.

rijal-051.en: O righteous daughter and profiting young woman, Ruqayya: when I read of your praiseworthy effort and your trade that will never perish, I prayed to Allah for you with what I hope will be answered, so that your eye may be cooled.

rijal-052.en: And know that your performing the Tijānī daily office (waẓīfa) apart from people is better for you in religion, in this world and in the hereafter. For the company of one whose heart is not attached to the Shaykh in all his breaths cuts the disciple off from arrival, or holds him back from it. None will censure you for it except one ignorant of the path (ṭarīqa) and of the states of its people; for the people of special election (ahl al-khuṣūṣiyya) have rulings particular to them. «And you will surely know its tidings after a while» (Q. 38:88). Peace.

rijal-053.en: And there is no mark of honour (karāma) greater than service to me, for one who has inner sight; but Allah has veiled that so that the shares may differ in excellence. And whoever fell short in serving us will regret it when it appears that all are in my grasp.

rijal-054.en: I and my beloved ones are men of Saloum; / He will gather us in the company (zumra) of Ibn Sālim.

rijal-055.en: Lord of the servants, Forgiver of sins / and Accepter of repentance: accept my repentance.

rijal-056.en:
«al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah), Lord of the worlds, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, King of the Day of Judgement. You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help» (Q. 1:2–5). «And who is better in speech than one who calls to Allah, does righteous deeds, and says, 'I am of the Muslims'?» (Q. 41:33). The Aḥmadī Tijānī Ibrāhīmī path is built upon the Book and the Sunna: it is asking forgiveness, blessing upon the Prophet ﷺ, and 'There is no god but Allah'.

«al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh, Lord of the worlds, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, King of the Day of Judgement. You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help» (Q. 1:2–5). «And who is better in speech than one who calls to Allah, does righteous deeds, and says, 'I am of the Muslims'?» (Q. 41:33). To proceed: Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Kawlakhī says: I have given my son and disciple al-Sayyid ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Sayyid Jāj complete permission to recite the Tijānī wirds …

rijal-057.en:
Shaykh al-Islām al-Ḥājj Ibrāhīm Niasse
Kaolack, 24/12/1388
al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah), who said: «and their affair is consultation among them» (Q. 42:38).
The Tijānī Flood (fayḍa) has its origin in the Muḥammadan Reality (al-ḥaqīqa al-Muḥammadiyya), and it forms a supreme council of consultation that meets twice in three months …

rijal-058.en:
«So We have removed from you your covering, and your sight today is sharp» (Q. 50:22).
You will be healed before the appointed time; keep to it always. Peace. Ibrāhīm Niasse.

rijal-059.en: If your finger pains you again, recite: «On the Day the sky will sway with a swaying, and the mountains will move — mo— mo— mo—» (Q. 52:9–10), then spit lightly on the hand.

rijal-060.en: Peace in which there is no idle talk and no sin, upon you, O beloved son ʿUthmān b. Muṣʿab.

rijal-061.en: So know that I — and there is no power and no strength except through Allah, the High, the Mighty — heard from the tongue of him who does not speak from desire that no created being will harm me at all, whoever it may be.

rijal-062.en: … for whoever is connected to him is connected to us, and whoever is connected to us is connected to our Lord; and «to your Lord is the final end» (Q. 53:42).

rijal-063.en: and that He grant us the sweetness of life and the sweetness of death, cause us to die in love of the Tijānī Seal, and gather us in his party in the gathering-place of the prophets and messengers and in the neighbourhood of the master of existence ﷺ, in the highest ʿIlliyyūn, «in a seat of truth with a Sovereign, All-Powerful» (Q. 54:55).

rijal-064.en: Then he wrote to him once: “O you who desire arrival, ʿUthmān b. Aḥmad, tell me: what is your belief concerning the Essence of our Master, majestic is His majesty, which has no where, no how and no time? Rather, ⟨Allah was, and there was nothing with Him; and He is now as He was⟩. To it the noble verse that removed every veil points, namely His words, glorified and exalted is He: «He is the First and the Last, the Outward and the Inward» (Q. 57:3). So understand — may Allah draw you by the pull of [His] solicitude to the Presence of Holiness, and annihilate you from yourself until there remains to you neither entity nor trace, neither intellect nor vestige, except by the Real, for the Real, in the Real, from the Real. Peace. Keep my letter, use your intellect to understand its meaning, and know that it is the greatest secret you will find: by understanding it your journeying ends, if Allah wills.”

rijal-065.en:
From Ṭayba I bestow [favour] upon the outward folk [?], / and You know my inward and my outward.
He has attained his hopes who came to me first / and last — O Last, O First!

rijal-066.en: And I have, praise be to Allah the Exalted, chains of transmission from all the khalīfas of the Shaykh [al-Tijānī], may Allah be pleased with him, whom I met, which I have gathered in quires; and from the Shaykh, may Allah be pleased with him, without intermediary. «That is the bounty of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills; and Allah is Possessor of great bounty» (Q. 62:4).

rijal-067.en: So the Shaykh, may Allah be pleased with him, wrote to him: “May Allah give you in exchange something better than it. Peace. Ibrāhīm b. al-Ḥājj ʿAbd Allāh al-Tijānī.”

rijal-068.en: The Creator gives you glad tidings of the vision of His Face, / and of the face of a beloved beyond whose face there is no beyond.

rijal-069.en: And blessing and peace upon the first to emerge of the self-disclosures (tajalliyāt), the servant whom the Real made master and to whom He gave a great kingdom; and upon his Family and his Companions, whom Allah made fit to be, for the Chosen One and his religion, a support.

rijal-070.en: You are the Rich, the Powerful, the One who wills, / and nothing comes to be but what You will … since You are the Living, the Loving, the Sufficing.

rijal-071.en: To proceed: I have licensed you … in all the secrets of the Tijānī path (ṭarīqa) contained in our notebook (kunnāsh) and elsewhere, and in the use of the special properties (khawāṣṣ) of the Names and of the verses of the Qurʾan … And I ask Allah the Exalted to bless you in them, and to teach you and provide for you by the pen.

rijal-072.en: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, alone, without partner, one in His Essence, His attributes and His acts: «He is Allah, One; Allah, the Self-Sufficient; He did not beget and was not begotten, and there is none equal to Him» (Q. 112:1–4).

rijal-113.en:
From the city of Kaolack, 8 Dhū al-Qaʿda 1373 … My son al-Sayyid Aḥmad, may Allah preserve you and watch over you: I commit you to the safekeeping of Allah the Exalted.
Pray the two rakʿas of travel before the afternoon prayer with al-Fātiḥa and the two suras of refuge (al-Muʿawwidhatān), and go to the mosque to pray the obligatory [prayer] …

rihlat-001.en: Had I taken the trouble, I would have brought, for every act I performed, its proof from the Sunna. «My success is only through Allah» (Q. 11:88).

rihlat-002.en: I prayed two rakʿas on Thursday, the ninth of Shawwāl, in the year dated at its head [i.e. at the head of this account]. In the first I recited al-Fātiḥa and «Say: O you disbelievers» (Q. 109:1), and in the second al-Fātiḥa and al-Ikhlāṣ, although a report has come that they are [recited] with al-Falaq and al-Nās.

rihlat-003.en: I gave the closing salutation, recited Āyat al-Kursī and Sūrat Li-īlāf Quraysh, and supplicated with the transmitted supplication.

rihlat-004.en: … and provide me with more good than I ask, and turn every evil away from me. «My Lord, open my breast for me, and make my affair easy for me» (Q. 20:25–26).

rihlat-006.en: When I had settled upon its back, I said: «Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us, though we could not have mastered it; and to our Lord we shall surely return» (Q. 43:13–14).

rihlat-007.en: ⟨Glory be to You, O Allah! «I have wronged myself, so forgive me» (Q. 28:16); none forgives sins but You.⟩

rihlat-010.en: I boarded the steam train (al-bābūr) and said: «In Allah's Name be its course and its mooring; my Lord is truly Forgiving, Merciful» (Q. 11:41); «They did not measure Allah with His true measure» (Q. 39:67), [to the end of] the verse.

rihlat-011.en: We went aboard the steamship called 'Canada' at the time of the sun's declination, and there we recited the verses mentioned earlier, I mean His saying, the Exalted: «And he said: Embark in it; in Allah's Name be its course and its mooring; my Lord is truly Forgiving, Merciful» (Q. 11:41); «They did not measure Allah with His true measure» (Q. 39:67), [to the end of] the verse.

rihlat-012.en: “O Allah, Yours is the praise. I have gone away from all my loved ones, and they have gone away from me, heading toward You; the bounty and the favour are Yours. O Allah, «accept from us; You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing» (Q. 2:127).”

rihlat-013.en: I saw men with beautiful faces. I recognised none of them except Shaykh al-Tijānī, may Allah be pleased with him, and my father, may Allah the Exalted have mercy on him. He laced his fingers with my fingers and said: Recite «Truly Allah is not ashamed» (Q. 2:26) to the end of «And when We delivered you» (Q. 2:49). So I recited up to the section (ḥizb) «And when they meet» (Q. 2:76).

rihlat-014.en: With praise to Allah, we went on travelling in health and well-being, with ample blessings from Allah, the sea calm and the sky clear, until the Canada cast her anchors at Las Palmas, capital of Spain.

rihlat-015.en: Peace be upon you, O you through whom Allah guided the servants and set the lands aright, and through whom He guided to the path of right conduct.

rihlat-016.en: Peace be upon you from me, from my father and what he begot, from my companions, my family and my children, and from whoever is attached to us.

rihlat-018.en: We supplicated Allah at his side; the eyes overflowed with tears, and weeping overcame me until I was dazed.

rihlat-020.en: We boarded it shortly before sunset on the eve of Thursday, with one night remaining of Shawwāl, and I said: «In Allah's Name be its course and its mooring» (Q. 11:41). Allah subjected to us this mighty sea of grave peril, so there was no pitching and no drowsing.

rihlat-021.en: We acted on what the verse «O you who believe, when you confer privately with the Messenger…» (Q. 58:12) requires, even though it is abrogated, because only its obligation was abrogated.

rihlat-022.en: Then we said what Allah the Exalted said: «Had they, when they wronged themselves, come to you and sought Allah's forgiveness, and had the Messenger sought forgiveness for them, they would have found Allah Ever-Relenting, Merciful» (Q. 4:64).

rihlat-023.en: We supplicated for ourselves, for our parents, our brothers and those attached to us, and for all the believing men and believing women and the Muslim men and Muslim women.

rihlat-024.en: And [by] «those who stand, who bow, who prostrate» (Q. 22:26), / from the beginning of existence to its end.

rihlat-025.en: And [by] Uḥud and the martyrs of its Uḥud, / and a Household bowing, prostrating.

rihlat-026.en:
And grant this lowly servant what he seeks; / nay, grant him more than he asks.
And forgive him, Lord, and his parents, / and his offspring, and whoever is affiliated to him.

rihlat-027.en: And let the word of Islam surely be raised high; / unite the hearts of its eminent people.

rihlat-028.en: in all the regions of the lands, O Gentle One; / and let the word of Islam surely be raised high.

rihlat-033.en: And make faith and spiritual excellence (iḥsān) firm, / and deliver us from «hardship and affliction» (Q. 2:214).

rihlat-034.en: In it we saw the window of unveiling through which the Kaʿba was unveiled to him when he wished to change the qibla, the kneeling-place of the she-camel, and the place where the verse came down; all of that is marked.

rihlat-037.en: We made that on Tuesday, which is the second day. Those in haste hastened [to depart], and we stayed on without haste, and the praise is Allah's.

rihlat-038.en: We visited a cave in which the Prophet ﷺ sat and in which Sūrat al-Mursalāt was revealed to him, a mosque in which Sūrat al-Kawthar was revealed, and the place where the ram by which Ismāʿīl was ransomed came down.

rihlat-039.en: May Allah reward them both with good, and reward the Sultan of Kano. «Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us, though we could not have mastered it» (Q. 43:13).

rihlat-040.en: And al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah), who showed us our rites; and «al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh, who guided us to this; we would not have been guided had Allah not guided us» (Q. 7:43); and «if you count Allah's blessing, you cannot number it» (Q. 14:34; 16:18).

rihlat-043.en: I see myself today at al-Ṭūr, having come to stay, / winning a secret through which he came [to be] the one spoken to.

rihlat-046.en: – and not putting on the robe of feeling safe from the scheming of Allah the Exalted.

rihlat-057.en: May Allah grant us and all our loved ones sincerity in servanthood and the fulfilment of what Lordship is owed, and return to the Two Noble Sanctuaries time after time; and may He take charge of us and of them, «for He takes charge of the righteous» (Q. 7:196).

rihlat-107.en: «al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah)», and [that] suffices; «and peace upon His servants whom He has chosen» (Q. 27:59).

rihlat-108.en: Praise to Him in whose Reminder [stands] «Say: travel / through the land» (Q. 29:20), [from] one to whom the Bearer of Glad Tidings came by night.

rihlat-110.en: The Subtle One (al-Laṭīf) drove me toward Kankan, / and the Lord gave me the station of "Be! Be!" (kun kun).

rihlat-111.en: and his daughter al-Zahrāʾ, my wife — may she see / delight of the eye in [her] sons, and may I see [it].

rihlat-112.en:
I travelled toward Sikkar [Siguiri?] of the Sudan, / then on to Bamako in the evening.
I do not know whether its name, as spoken, is the word saqar (Hellfire) — / glory be to Him who placed lessons in names!

rihlat-116.en: He has singled me out with knowledge and with the power of free disposal (taṣrīf): / if I say "Be!", it is, without delay.

rihlat-117.en:
But I took Him as Trustee (wakīl) out of courtesy (taʾaddub), / and so He chose me as intimate friend (khalīl).
And I said: there is no god but Allah; / Muḥammad — the Divinity (al-ilāh) sent him.

rihlat-118.en: But I took Him as Trustee (wakīl) out of courtesy (taʾaddub), / and so He chose me as intimate friend (khalīl).

rihlat-119.en: Then His secret flooded from me, so that no one / comes to me without coming to know Allah, the Everlasting Refuge (al-Ṣamad).

rihlat-121.en: This servant, tried with renown, has feared / his Lord's stratagem (makr), and so he is wary.

rihlat-122.en:
I have not given women leave for privacy (khalwa) [with me] / at the hour of their visit, at the time of public audience (jalwa),
except wives (ḥalāʾil), or women within the forbidden degrees (maḥārim), / or a servant whom [my hand] has possessed after these.

rihlat-125.en: I came to Kindia and spent the night there; / my Lord's favour I am unable to count.

rihlat-126.en:
And there, as for my khalīfa, there came to me / the announcement of his death, and it grieved me.
We belong to Allah; to Him we return. / So be pleased with him, and gather what is scattered.

rihlat-127.en: [This was] «the interpretation of my dream» (Q. 12:100) that I had seen; / with every act of my Creator I am content.

rihlat-128.en: I reminded them with a reminder that removes the rust (rayn), / clears away the tarnish, and may remove the veil (ghayn).

rihlat-129.en: They have multiplied blessing and greeting of peace / upon a Prophet who has never ceased to be compassionate.

rihlat-130.en:
A child whom his father entrusted to my care — / and that is a matter that has long worn me down.
I reached it only after hardship to the soul; / I became certain that I have no share (ḥaẓẓ) in my self.

rihlat-133.en: The servant has no power and no strength; / I have committed my affair to the Protector (al-Walī) — how just He is!

rihlat-137.en:
He was gladdened by me when I saw him, and / I too was gladdened, for he is the gate of supply (madad).
«Help from Allah and a victory» drawing near / in it — this is the date, for whoever watches for it.

rihlat-138.en: I have fortified them with the Living and the Self-Subsisting (al-Ḥayy wa-l-Qayyūm), / that He may guard them so that they attain my aim.

rihlat-139.en: May Allah strengthen him with His help, for he / is a pious, righteous shaykh, and he has understanding.

rihlat-143.en: And grant us blessed offspring / who belong to Allah without partner.

rihlat-145.en: by the Chosen One (al-Muṣṭafā), the intercessor on the Day of Gathering, / the best of creation, who has been granted al-Kawthar,

rihlat-146.en: «al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah), Lord of the worlds» (Q. 1:2).

rihlat-147.en: The journey took place on the last night of Dhū al-Ḥijja in the year 1366 AH — upon its master [the Prophet] ﷺ — «and Allah will never grant the unbelievers a way over the believers» (Q. 4:141); and it ended with the return to Medina on the last day of Ṣafar 1367 (in it: «help from Allah and a near victory» (Q. 61:13)). And al-Ḥamdu li-Llāh (The Praise is for Allah), by whose favour and majesty good works are completed. End.

rihlat-148.en: and it ended with the return to Medina on the last day of Ṣafar 1367 (in it: «help from Allah and a near victory» (Q. 61:13))

hikam-p3-12.en: The Throne (ʿarsh) is sharʿ inverted… so the revealed Law (sharʿ) is the whole of the earth's mercy and the place where it alights.

hikam-p5-17.en: Of the science of dialectical theology (ʿilm al-kalām), this verse suffices a person: «Were there gods in them other than Allah, both would have fallen into ruin» (Q. 21:22), as regards the oneness (tawḥīd) of the acts, of the attributes and of the Essence.

hikam-p5-21.en: Light is of four kinds: a light that shows you and is not seen; a light that shows you and is seen, like the light of the eye; a light that shows you only, like the light of the intellect; and a light that shows you the existent and shows you the non-existent, and that is «Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth» (Q. 24:35). He likened the heart of the believer to the glass to teach you… for glass breaks quickly, and so does the heart; so guard it closely.

hikam-p7-30.en: The soul cannot attain tranquillity except through knowledge of Allah (maʿrifa). As for the souls of the people of this world, they do not attain tranquillity, because they are perpetually avid in seeking.

rihlat-058.en: Praise to Him who taught us in [Sūrat] al-Baqara / the rulings of the hajj to the House, when He mentioned it.

rihlat-059.en: And [blessings] upon his family, the leaders of the elect, / so long as «He wraps the night over the day» (Q. 39:5).

rihlat-061.en:
We flew to Lagos reciting the Reminder (al-dhikr): / «Glory be to» Him who sent it down, Him «who carried
His servant by night from the Sacred [Mosque] / to the Furthest Mosque» (Q. 17:1), without sleeping.

rihlat-064.en: I came to the palace of Rome [?]; Rome, indeed, / «has been overcome» (Q. 30:2), and never will it rise.

rihlat-067.en: And I ran between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwa, / the company with me; I was granted [?] the retreat (khalwa).

rihlat-070.en: I found intimacy (uns), and the session ran its course, / and in it was «all that the souls desired» (Q. 43:71).

rihlat-071.en:
My Lord descended to vaunt before the [heavenly] assembly / the assembly of the hajj; and when He descended,
He said, «Pour forth» (Q. 2:199), for the sins are forgiven / for all of you; likewise the faults are veiled.

rihlat-072.en: And the mountains were crushed when I conversed in intimate prayer, / and I came to Him — and yet I did not come.

rihlat-076.en: Upon him may Allah, his Generous Lord, send blessings / to the measure of his rank and his «tremendous character» (Q. 68:4).

rihlat-077.en: And the weak — there is no blame upon them, / still more so when they have passed out of their senses.

rihlat-078.en: And my Mount (ṭūr) was crushed; then, when He conversed with me intimately, / I became Mūsā, and He had taken me as a sincere friend.

rihlat-079.en: Of the illness there remained neither trace nor vestige; / glory be to Him who raises [up] in the twinkling of an eye.

rihlat-080.en: May they live in well-being, all of them, in Kano, / and after that dwell «in ʿIlliyyūn» (Q. 83:18–19).

rihlat-081.en: I rode back, returning to my Lord, repentant, / to my land, in longing and in awe.

rihlat-082.en: I saw Ṣāliḥ, and al-ʿAbbās came, / and people came to me «from every mountain pass» (Q. 22:27).

rihlat-083.en: They came to enter the Path (ṭarīqa), / troop after troop; they submitted [to Allah] in truth.

rihlat-084.en: Likewise women «submitting, believing», / and good, «guarding, remembering» (Q. 33:35).

rihlat-085.en:
And [by] the rank of his grandfather, the Prophet, Ilyās [?], / best of creation, destroyer of «the slinking one» (Q. 114:4),
upon him may Allah send blessings, with gracious intimacy, / and upon the Family and the Companions, the cure of «the whisperer» (Q. 114:4).

rihlat-090.en: I ask Him for success (tawfīq) for me and for you, / so that there be no blindness, deafness or dumbness.

rihlat-093.en: After that I returned to al-Jarrār, / whose flood (fayḍ) is «like a downpour» (Q. 2:19), abundant.

rihlat-096.en: I ask Him of His tremendous bounty, / and by His Name the Subtly Kind (al-Laṭīf) and the Generous (al-Karīm).

rihlat-097.en: And the troops entered into the Path (ṭarīqa), / and found the good in truth.

rihlat-100.en:
The Bestower (al-Mannān) strengthened me in the journeys, / so I am not in need of breaking the fast
in Ramadan, whether away or at home, / even if I fall ill or press on [?] travelling.

rihlat-103.en:
I returned from Accra to the family; / were it not for them, my scope would have widened
for the service of Islam. Truly, a day / in this country is like a thousand; leave off reproach.
